transmissionMode.description: BitDreamIT ASTM E1381-02 with full state machine, multiple checksum algorithms (SUM_MOD_256/LRC/CRC8/CUSTOM), exponential backoff with jitter, per-phase timeouts, dialect support (LIS02-A/LIS01-A/VENDOR_CUSTOM), keepalive, and protocol packet capture.
